scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build.mjs && node scripts/require-typescript-7.mjs && tsc -b && pnpm --filter ./editors/vscode build:bundle
scripts.verify: pnpm quality && pnpm test && pnpm coverage && pnpm build && pnpm docs:build && pnpm performance:gate
scripts.quality: pnpm postgres:catalog:check && pnpm mysql:catalog:check && biome check .
scripts.conformance:live: pnpm conformance:live:postgres && pnpm conformance:live:mysql && pnpm conformance:live:sqlite
scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/e2e-postgres generate:snapshot && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/e2e-mysql generate:snapshot && pnpm --filter './examples/**' --if-present generate:snapshot && pnpm --filter './packages/**' --if-present test && pnpm --filter './editors/**' --if-present test && pnpm --filter './examples/**' --if-present test && pnpm test:contracts
scripts.test:editor-matrix: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/e2e-postgres generate:snapshot && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/e2e-mysql generate:snapshot && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/ts-bridge test && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/language-server test && poku test/contracts/typescript-compatibility.test.ts --reporter=compact --enforce
scripts.test:soundness: poku packages/postgres/test/soundness.test.ts packages/mysql/test/soundness.test.ts packages/sqlite/test/soundness.test.ts packages/compiler/test/soundness.test.ts packages/cli/test/soundness.test.ts packages/ts-bridge/test/soundness.test.ts packages/language-server/test/soundness.test.ts --reporter=compact --enforce
scripts.release:artifacts: pnpm build && node scripts/verify-release-artifacts.mjs --output artifacts/release/artifacts.json && pnpm test:pack
scripts.release:rc: pnpm release:assert rc && node scripts/publish-prerelease.mjs rc
scripts.release:companions: pnpm release:assert stable && node scripts/publish-prerelease.mjs companions
scripts.release:stable: pnpm release:assert stable && node scripts/publish-prerelease.mjs stable
scripts.release:check: pnpm editor:promotion:review && pnpm verify && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/e2e-packed e2e && pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high
scripts.coverage: pnpm --filter @typed-sql/core coverage && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/ast coverage && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/schema coverage && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/config coverage && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/compiler coverage && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/conformance coverage && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/opentelemetry coverage && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/postgres coverage && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/mysql coverage && pnpm --filter @typed-sql/sqlite coverage
